zh.title: Yoohee Tracker
zh.subtitle: GF2 Local Gacha Tracker
zh.importInstructions: 文件导入：本工具导出的 JSON、ElmoBeacon 数据库 .db、gf2gacha的数据库.db。
zh.confirmClear: 确认清空浏览器本地记录？导出的文件不会受影响。
zh.officialGuideTitle: 游戏服务器记录拉取指南 (参考自 gfl2.help)
zh.fiddlerTip: 粘贴 Fiddler 里 /list?game_channel_id= 的完整请求，或手动填 URL 与 Headers。保存前仍会进入左侧导入预览，不会直接写入本地库。
zh.fiddlerDownload: 下载并安装 Fiddler Classic（可通过 官方直接下载链接 获得）。
zh.fiddlerConfigure: 打开并配置 Fiddler Classic（只需配置一次）：
zh.fiddlerStepCert: 勾选 [Decrypt HTTPS traffic]（解密 HTTPS 流量），安装并信任证书
zh.fiddlerStepTraffic: 建议选择 [from non-browsers only] 或 [all traffic]
zh.fiddlerStepRestart: 配置完成后，重启 Fiddler Classic
zh.fiddlerRecruitStep: 在游戏中打开 招募 → 点击左下角 访问详情 → 点击 访问记录 选项卡，加载出抽卡记录表格。
zh.fiddlerSessionStep: 返回 Fiddler Classic，在左侧会话列表中找到一条 URL 以 /list?game_channel_id= 开头的请求。
zh.fiddlerCopyStep: 选中该条请求，按下键盘 Ctrl + Shift + C 复制该请求的完整文本（这包含了所需的 Authorization 头）。
zh.fiddlerPasteStep: 将复制的内容粘贴到下方的文本框中。本工具将自动提取其中的 URL 与 Headers 进行拉取。
zh.confirmMessage: 此操作不可逆，确定清空吗？
zh.searchPlaceholder: 输入名称、ID、服务器等搜索...
zh.serverPullHelp: 服务器拉取：使用 UID、抽卡记录 URL 和解密后的 URL Headers 请求游戏服务器记录，再进入同一个预览合并流程。
zh.manualEntryHelp: 仅用于补入缺失的 5星出货，完整记录建议优先用服务器拉取或文件导入。
zh.manualNote: 人工补录仅写入 5 星记录，按当前选中的卡池类型保存。
zh.syncFromOfficialApi: 从游戏服务器记录接口同步
zh.captureAgentDownloadTooltip: 下载 Windows 本地捕获助手压缩包（含启动脚本，需已安装 Node.js 20+）
zh.githubRepoTooltip: 在 GitHub 上查看源代码
zh.captureAgentHelp: 启动独立 GFL2 捕获助手后，点击“允许本地助手连接”。助手只提供临时凭据，记录仍由本页面直接从官方接口抓取。
zh.captureCredentialLoaded: 凭据已载入；点击抓取并预览即可从官方接口同步。
zh.captureAgentUnavailable: 无法连接本地捕获助手，请确认它已启动且地址正确。
zh.captureCredentialInvalid: 凭据无效、已失效或不是 GFL2 官方抽卡接口凭据。
zh.captureCredentialWarning: 凭据含有临时授权信息，只在当前页面内存中使用，不会写入 Tracker 数据库。导出的凭据文件使用后请立即删除。
zh.captureAgentStatusFailed: 无法读取助手状态，请确认地址和助手窗口。
zh.captureCredentialNotReady: 助手还没有捕获到官方请求。请先打开游戏内抽卡记录，再重试。
zh.captureAgentUrlInvalid: 助手地址无效：请使用本机地址，例如 http://127.0.0.1:17890。
zh.captureAgentStepStart: 还没装助手？点上面的「下载助手」获取压缩包并解压；双击 启动gfl2捕获助手.cmd（需 Node.js 20+），并保持助手窗口运行。
zh.captureAgentStepCode: 如果自动匹配失败，再展开备用方式并输入助手窗口显示的一次性配对码。
zh.captureAgentStepGame: 打开游戏的 招募 → 访问详情 → 访问记录，等记录表出现。
zh.captureAgentStepCheck: 网页会自动检查助手状态；必要时再点击右上角刷新按钮。
zh.captureAgentStepConnect: 点击“允许本地助手连接”，在本机确认窗口中点击允许。
zh.captureAgentStepFetch: 点击“抓取并预览”，确认新增记录后再写入本地库。
zh.captureAgentUidHint: 助手未能自动识别 UID：在游戏主界面点击左下角的齿轮图标（设置），进入「玩家名片」页面即可查看 UID，点击可复制，然后粘贴到上面的输入框。
zh.captureAgentUidHowTo: 获取 UID：在游戏主界面点击左下角的齿轮图标（设置），进入「玩家名片」页面即可查看 UID，点击可复制，然后粘贴到左侧输入框。
zh.capturePairingFallback: 无法自动连接？使用备用方式
zh.capturePairingExplain: 点击允许连接后，网页会自动等待并读取游戏请求。
zh.capturePairingApproved: 已连接本地助手；打开游戏抽卡记录后会自动读取。
zh.captureGrantExpired: 本地助手似乎已重启，之前的授权已失效，请重新点击「允许本地助手连接」。
zh.capturePairingPopupBlocked: 浏览器阻止了本地确认窗口，请允许此网站弹窗后重试。
zh.capturePairingOriginNotAllowed: 此网页地址不在助手允许列表中，请使用官方地址或配对码备用方式。
zh.fiddlerGuideSummary: 查看 Fiddler 完整使用说明
zh.fiddlerRequestPlaceholder: Fiddler 请求文本或解密后的 URL Headers
zh.pullExplainText: 将拉取常规采购、定向采购、军备提升等类型的所有记录。如果粘贴完整 Fiddler 请求，会自动识别服务器和 URL。
zh.fetchOverlayHint: 正在向游戏服务器请求各卡池记录，请稍候…
zh.resourceIndexLoadedStatus: 资源索引已载入：{count} 个物品
zh.fileParsedStatus: 已解析 {file}：{count} 条，预计新增 {added} 条
zh.decryptCompleteStatus: 解密完成：{count} 条记录，预计新增 {added} 条
zh.decryptNoRecordsStatus: 解密完成，但未识别到可导入的记录
zh.importCompleteStatus: 导入完成：新增 {added} 条，重复 {duplicates} 条
zh.manualDuplicateStatus: 这条人工记录与现有数据重复，未新增
zh.remoteFetchCompleteStatus: 远程抓取完成：{count} 条，预计新增 {added} 条
zh.localLoadedStatus: 已载入 {count} 条本地记录
zh.localEmptyStatus: 本地库为空，请先导入数据
zh.encryptedBackupTitle: 选择 exilium.xyz 网站加密备份并在网页端解密
zh.decryptExiliumBackup: 解密 exilium.xyz 网站备份
zh.decryptBackupNote: 会调用 exilium.xyz 网站的解密接口，解密结果只在本页预览，确认后才写入本地数据库。

en.title: Yoohee Tracker
en.subtitle: GF2 Local Gacha Tracker
en.importInstructions: Import: Supports exporter JSON, ElmoBeacon .db database, and gf2gacha .db database.
en.confirmClear: Are you sure you want to clear browser local records? Your exported backup files will not be affected.
en.fiddlerTip: Paste the Fiddler `/list?game_channel_id=` full request or manually input URL & Headers. You can review items in the preview area before saving.
en.fiddlerDownload: Download and install Fiddler Classic (via Official Direct Link).
en.fiddlerConfigure: Open and configure Fiddler Classic (one-time setup):
en.fiddlerStepCert: Check [Decrypt HTTPS traffic], install and trust root certificate
en.fiddlerStepRestart: Restart Fiddler Classic after saving configuration
en.fiddlerRecruitStep: In-game go to Recruitment → Click lower-left Access Details → Click Access Records tab, wait for table to load.
en.fiddlerSessionStep: Return to Fiddler, look for a session ending with `/list?game_channel_id=` in the list.
en.fiddlerCopyStep: Select the session, press Ctrl+Shift+C to copy full request details (including Authorization header).
en.fiddlerPasteStep: Paste copied content into the text box below. The tool will parse URL and Headers automatically.
en.confirmMessage: This action cannot be undone. Are you sure you want to clear your data?
en.serverPullHelp: Sync Server: Request game server records using UID, record URL, and decrypted headers, then proceed to the merge preview.
en.manualEntryHelp: Used only to manually add missing 5★ pulls. For full records, server sync or file import is recommended.
en.manualNote: Manual entry only registers 5★ records and saves them under the selected pool type.
en.captureAgentDownloadTooltip: Download the Windows local capture agent bundle (includes launcher; requires Node.js 20+)
en.githubRepoTooltip: View the source code on GitHub
en.captureAgentHelp: Start the standalone GFL2 capture agent, then click Allow local agent connection. The agent only provides a temporary credential; this page fetches records directly from the official API.
en.captureCredentialLoaded: Credential loaded; click Fetch & Preview to sync directly from the official API.
en.captureAgentUnavailable: Cannot connect to the local capture agent. Check that it is running and the address is correct.
en.captureCredentialInvalid: The credential is invalid, expired, or not for an official GFL2 gacha endpoint.
en.captureCredentialWarning: The credential contains temporary authorization data. It is kept only in this page's memory and is not stored in the Tracker database. Delete exported credential files immediately after use.
en.captureAgentStatusFailed: Cannot read agent status. Check the address and agent window.
en.captureCredentialNotReady: The agent has not captured an official request yet. Open the in-game gacha history and try again.
en.captureAgentUrlInvalid: Invalid agent address. Use a local address such as http://127.0.0.1:17890.
en.captureAgentStepStart: No agent yet? Click "Download agent" above to get the bundle and unzip it; double-click Start-GFL2-Capture-Agent.cmd (requires Node.js 20+) and keep the agent window open.
en.captureAgentStepCode: If automatic pairing fails, expand the fallback section and enter the one-time code shown in the agent window.
en.captureAgentStepGame: Open Recruitment → Details → History in the game and wait for the table.
en.captureAgentStepCheck: The page checks the agent automatically; use the refresh button only if needed.
en.captureAgentStepConnect: Click Allow local agent connection, then click Allow in the local confirmation window.
en.captureAgentStepFetch: Click Fetch & Preview, review new records, then write them to the local database.
en.captureAgentUidHint: The agent could not detect your UID automatically: tap the gear icon in the bottom-left corner of the game's main screen (Settings), open the Player Card page to see your UID — tap it to copy, then paste it into the field above.
en.captureAgentUidHowTo: Find your UID: tap the gear icon in the bottom-left corner of the game's main screen (Settings), open the Player Card page to see your UID — tap it to copy, then paste it into the field on the left.
en.capturePairingExplain: After you allow the connection, this page waits for and reads the game request automatically.
en.capturePairingApproved: Local agent connected; open the in-game gacha history and the request will be read automatically.
en.captureGrantExpired: The local agent seems to have restarted and the previous authorization is no longer valid. Click "Allow local agent connection" again.
en.capturePairingPopupBlocked: The browser blocked the local confirmation window. Allow pop-ups for this site and try again.
en.capturePairingOriginNotAllowed: This page is not in the agent allowlist. Use the official address or the pairing-code fallback.
en.fiddlerRequestPlaceholder: Fiddler request raw text or decrypted URL Headers
en.pullExplainText: Will fetch all records for Standard Procurement, Targeted Procurement, and Military Upgrade. Pasting a full Fiddler request will automatically parse the server and URL.
en.fetchOverlayHint: Requesting each banner's records from the game server, please wait…
en.decryptNoRecordsStatus: Decryption complete, but no importable records were found
en.manualDuplicateStatus: This manual record duplicates existing data and was not added
en.remoteFetchCompleteStatus: Remote sync complete: {count} records, {added} expected new
en.localEmptyStatus: Local database is empty. Import data first.
en.encryptedBackupTitle: Select an encrypted exilium.xyz website backup and decrypt it in the browser
en.decryptBackupNote: The exilium.xyz website decrypt endpoint is called by the page. The result is only previewed here and is written locally after confirmation.

jp.manualEntryHelp: 不足している★5の履歴を補完するためだけに使用します。すべてのデータを導入する場合はサーバー同期またはファイル導入を推奨します。

jp.captureAgentHelp: 独立した GFL2 キャプチャエージェントを起動し、「ローカルエージェントの接続を許可」を押します。エージェントは一時的な認証情報だけを提供し、履歴はこのページが公式APIから直接取得します。

jp.captureCredentialLoaded: 認証情報を読み込みました。「取得してプレビュー」で公式APIから同期できます。
jp.captureAgentUnavailable: ローカルキャプチャエージェントに接続できません。起動状態とアドレスを確認してください。
jp.captureCredentialInvalid: 認証情報が無効、期限切れ、または GFL2 公式調達API用ではありません。
jp.captureCredentialWarning: 認証情報には一時的な認証データが含まれます。現在のページのメモリ内だけで使用し、Trackerのデータベースには保存しません。エクスポートしたファイルは使用後すぐに削除してください。
